runtime_prompt_en:
Input image 1 is an appearance-only reference for visible adult facial structure, eye shape and spacing, face length, lower-face and jaw width, hairline, and hair. The output is a newly generated photograph in the scene below.

A photorealistic scene of an unmistakably adult woman with a softly tapered oval face, wide-set almond-shaped dark eyes, a long lower face and narrow jaw, a centered slightly peaked hairline, and long dark wavy hair in a wind-driven coastal salvage operation. On a storm-battered tidal platform, she braces a weathered orange salvage tarp with one boot and hauls a salt-stiffened rope, lifting a barnacle-covered brass ship's bell and tangled blue glass floats from a half-flooded skiff. Her hair, sailcloth, charts, and red ribbons stream offshore together. Wet rope and a carabiner lead from the near plane through the woman and skiff to a leaning beacon. Reflective rock pools, white foam channels, and dark cliff recesses create clear depth and clearly separable and verifiable visual relationships. Use a vertical medium-wide full-body frame with subject, bell, and rope unobstructed; a storm-cloud break builds a diagonal tonal ladder across bell, foam, and pools while cliff recesses keep midtones. One bright diffuse surface or specular highlight provides a clear near-white anchor across wet bronze, white foam, and reflective rock pools. Luminance approaches white through a gradual shoulder with several distinguishable bright steps across foam, metal reflection, and cloud sheen. Any fully clipped white area stays confined to a small specular or source core inside the bell reflection, with surrounding bright detail remaining visible. Surrounding highlight texture subtle hue and midtone separation remain visible across salt-stained bronze, wet orange fabric, blue glass, foam, and rock. The smooth highlight shoulder is not replaced by flat low contrast underexposure glow gray highlights or local HDR halos; edges around the bell, foam, hair, sailcloth, and beacon remain naturally separated.

Avoid: over-processed retouching, distorted fingers, cartoon style, plastic-looking skin, body distortion, fake-looking background, illustration look, low resolution, 3D render look, excessive HDR
